Fixtures are created IN THE CASE (FIFTH RULE) by scripts/seed-data/auth/mfa-fixtures.mjs: the account kind, the store and every flag come from the creator, never from a shared persona; the whole run is removed in Cleanup with teardown(runId). If the creator reports a fixtureGap for the kind this case needs, or the environment touched the state before the step that reads it, the case is BLOCKED, never FAIL.
Sign-in codes are read from the notification journal (MfaSignInEmailNotification for the account) with readLatestMfaCode; SMTP is not relied on, and no code within 90s is BLOCKED.
State under test: global off; the disposable store has StoreMode=Enabled; ONE confirmed-email customer. The code belongs to the USER, not to the challenge: a second password step inside the resend interval (30 s) sends no new email and the earlier code still signs in on the new ticket; a second password step after the interval sends a new code and the earlier code is dead. Time matters: the two variants are separated by a 31 s wait on purpose.
Steps:
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password, username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}) to obtain an admin Bearer token (no MFA setting has been touched yet; keep the token for the whole case)
[SETUP] import scripts/seed-data/auth/mfa-fixtures.mjs: init(); runId = a fresh 3-16 char [a-z0-9] string (it lands in emails, store ids and names)
[SETUP] store = createMfaStore(runId, {mode: 'Enabled'}) - an AGENT-TEST-MFA-<runId> store cloned from {{STORE_ID}} with an unresolvable .invalid URL (it can never capture the shared storefront); capture store.id and read StoreMode back ('Enabled')
[SETUP] account = createMfaAccount({runId, store, kind: 'customer-confirmed'}) - an @example.com account with password {{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}} whose flags the creator verified; capture account.email, account.userId
--- LAYER: Variant 1: second password step inside the interval ---
[CAPTURE] T0 = current UTC time, taken immediately before the request that should send the code
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=password, scope=offline_access, storeId=store.id, username=account.email, password={{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}
[CAPTURE] ticket1 = twoFactorToken of the response
[CAPTURE] code1 = readLatestMfaCode({email: account.email, after: T0, excludeIds: the journal rows already read}).code - the 6-digit value in the journal row body
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer and JSON body {"notificationType":"MfaSignInEmailNotification","keyword":account.email,"sort":"createdDate:desc","take":20}; capture the number of rows as rows1
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=password, scope=offline_access, storeId=store.id, username=account.email, password={{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}} (immediately, well inside 30 s)
[CAPTURE] ticket2 = twoFactorToken of the response; res2 = its status and code
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer and JSON body {"notificationType":"MfaSignInEmailNotification","keyword":account.email,"sort":"createdDate:desc","take":20}; capture the number of rows as rows2
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=mfa, scope=offline_access, storeId=store.id, two_factor_token=ticket2, code=code1 (the code of the FIRST challenge on the SECOND ticket)
[CAPTURE] v1 = the response
--- LAYER: Variant 2: second password step after the interval ---
[CAPTURE] T0 = current UTC time, taken immediately before the request that should send the code
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=password, scope=offline_access, storeId=store.id, username=account.email, password={{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}
[CAPTURE] ticket3 = twoFactorToken of the response (an accepted code frees the send at once)
[CAPTURE] code3 = readLatestMfaCode({email: account.email, after: T0, excludeIds: the journal rows already read}).code - the 6-digit value in the journal row body
[WAIT] 31 seconds (CodeResendInterval is 30 s by default)
[CAPTURE] T0 = current UTC time, taken immediately before the request that should send the code
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=password, scope=offline_access, storeId=store.id, username=account.email, password={{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}
[CAPTURE] ticket4 = twoFactorToken of the response
[CAPTURE] code4 = readLatestMfaCode({email: account.email, after: T0, excludeIds: the journal rows already read}).code - the 6-digit value in the journal row body
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=mfa, scope=offline_access, storeId=store.id, two_factor_token=ticket4, code=code3 (the code of the ABANDONED challenge on the newest ticket)
[CAPTURE] v2Old = the response
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=mfa, scope=offline_access, storeId=store.id, two_factor_token=ticket4, code=code4 (the newest code)
[CAPTURE] v2New = the response
Assertions:
[STATUS] res2 is HTTP 400 with two_factor_required and a new twoFactorToken: the password grant still issues a ticket inside the interval {SPEC} (vc-module-mfa#1: Resend limit: the password grant still issues a two-factor token, since the code sent shortly before is valid)
[COUNT] rows2 equals rows1: no second email inside the interval {SPEC} (vc-module-mfa#1: Resend limit: a code is sent to a user ... at most once per CodeResendInterval)
[STATUS] v1 is HTTP 200 with an access_token: the first email's code signs in on the second ticket, because the code is per user {SPEC} (vc-module-mfa#1: Resend limit: the code sent shortly before is valid)
[COUNT] code4 differs from code3 and a new journal row exists for it: after the interval a new password step sends a new code {SPEC} (vc-module-mfa#1: Accepted code: a new sign-in gets a new code)
[STATUS] v2Old is HTTP 400 with code invalid_code: the code of the abandoned earlier challenge does not sign in on the newest ticket {SPEC} (vc-module-mfa#1: Accepted code: only the last code sent is valid)
[STATUS] v2New is HTTP 200 with an access_token {SPEC} (vc-module-mfa#1: Token endpoint)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] the fixture creator (mfa-fixtures.mjs) reports no fixtureGap and no errors[] entry for the account kind and the store this case relies on
[API] response bodies are JSON with the documented error shape (error, code) and carry no stack trace
[NETWORK] no 5xx on /connect/token, /api/mfa/* or the journal call
Failure_Signals: a code from an abandoned earlier challenge signs in on a newer ticket after a new code was sent (codes are not killed by the next send); a second email inside the interval (mail-bomb); no email after the interval (the customer cannot get a code); a 5xx
Cleanup: teardown(runId) of mfa-fixtures.mjs: removes every AGENT-TEST-MFA entity of the run (accounts, contacts, organizations, role, store) and asserts zero residue
References: VCST-5904 · Archetype:STALE · Technique:EG · Behavior:auth.signin.mfa.resend

Title: MFA Backoffice — the code screen opened directly shows a localized message, never a raw key
Preconditions:
Fixtures are created IN THE CASE (FIFTH RULE) by scripts/seed-data/auth/mfa-fixtures.mjs: the account kind, the store and every flag come from the creator, never from a shared persona; the whole run is removed in Cleanup with teardown(runId). If the creator reports a fixtureGap for the kind this case needs, or the environment touched the state before the step that reads it, the case is BLOCKED, never FAIL.
State under test: global MFA is OFF and NO window is opened (the screen is reachable regardless of the setting once the module is installed); the browser has no Backoffice session and no two-factor cookie. The Backoffice code screen is opened by URL, without a password step before it.
Oracle note: no document states what a direct visit must show; the one thing every localized screen must hold is that the user never sees a raw translation key. The exact outcome (an error sentence, or a return to the login dialog) is recorded as {HYPOTHESIS} until the module owner states it.
Steps:
--- SCREEN: Backoffice, direct visit ---
[NAV] Navigate to {{BACK_URL}}/#!/sign-in-code in an anonymous browser session (empty cookies, empty storage)
[WAIT] wait for the page to FULLY load before anything is judged {OBSERVED} (REG-2026-10-26-1503; operator 2026-10-26: wait for full page load): (a) the localization resource request GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/localization... has completed (its response is received); (b) the page is idle (no pending network request for 1s); (c) then poll up to 5s, every 500ms, for an element with role=alert (the expiry explanation appears 1-3s after the Code form is first drawn); (d) if the alert still shows a dotted lower-case key (e.g. platform.blades.login.errors.login-failed), reload the page ONCE and repeat (a)-(c); only then assert. Until the Admin SPA localization has loaded the alert shows the raw key: that is page-load timing, not a product defect (operator decision 2026-10-26), so a key seen before (a)-(b) is never the state to judge
[ASSERT] Read the URL, every visible text on the screen (including the alert text and a 'Back to sign in' control) and any error message
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/currentuser from the browser session (cookies only, no Bearer); capture status and body as preCodeBody
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/currentuser with no cookie and no Bearer (anonymous control, same request shape); capture its status and body as anonBody
--- LAYER: Control: the language of the message ---
[SETUP] Language control: no language switch exists on this screen, so the comparison is made on the message key, not on the screen. Request the Backoffice localization resource for the key of the shown message (e.g. GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/localization?lang=en, then again with ?lang=<the account's language>, e.g. de) and read that same key in both; if the platform exposes only one language, or the key is absent from both, the comparison is NOT_RUN with that reason, never PASS
[ASSERT] The shown message equals the localization value of that key in the language the page was rendered in; the same key in the other language is a different string, or the language has no translation of it (record which)
Assertions:
[DOM] After the full-load wait (localization request completed, page idle, one reload if a dotted key was still shown), no visible text on the screen is a raw localization key (a dotted lower-case path such as platform.blades.login.errors.login-failed) {SPEC} (vc-module-mfa#1: Backoffice: multi-language strings)
[DOM] Within 5s of the direct visit the screen shows a localized explanation as a role=alert (observed 2026-10-23: "Your sign-in session has expired. Sign in again.") together with a "Back to sign in" control, or the login dialog; a disabled "Code" form with an active "Resend code" and no explanation after the 5s wait is the failure {SPEC} (vc-module-mfa#1: Backoffice: code screen) {OBSERVED} (VCST-5904 round 2, 2026-10-23: alert after 1-3s; REG-2026-10-26-1422 asserted at first paint, before it) {OBSERVED} (REG-2026-10-26-1503 + operator 2026-10-26: wait for full page load - the raw key shows only until the localization has loaded)
[BODY] currentuser carries no authenticated user (no userName, no id; status and body equal the anonymous control, observed HTTP 200 {}): opening the code screen by URL does not create a session; it must fail if userName or id is present {SPEC} (vc-module-mfa#1: Backoffice) {OBSERVED} (REG-2026-10-26-1422)
[BODY] {HYPOTHESIS} the shown message equals the localization value of its key in the language the page rendered in, and that key resolves differently (or is untranslated, recorded) in a second language; NOT_RUN with the reason when only one language is available
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS error on the page under test
[NETWORK] no 5xx on /connect/token or /api/mfa/resend
Failure_Signals: a raw translation key (platform.blades.login.errors.login-failed) is still shown after the full-load wait and one reload; a code input with no way to proceed; a session is created by the direct visit; spinner >5s, console.error with TypeError
Cleanup: Close the browser session; no entity was created and no setting was touched
References: VCST-5904 · Archetype:RENDER · Technique:EG · Behavior:auth.signin.mfa.backoffice

SHARED-IMPACT WINDOW (global): the case sets MultiFactorAuthentication.Enabled=true on {{BACK_URL}} and restores it in Cleanup. Security question for triage (NOT an expectation of this row): a bearer obtained this way has Backoffice API access without the second factor - whether the store override should reach non-customer accounts is a product decision. The case holds what the spec says and the deployed setting description contradicts (see MFA-027).

[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password, username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}) to obtain an admin Bearer token BEFORE the global MultiFactorAuthentication.Enabled setting is touched - with it on, this very grant answers two_factor_required and the journal needs an admin token. [SETUP] account = createMfaAccount({runId, kind: 'manager-backoffice'}) - an @example.com account with password {{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}} whose flags the creator verified; capture account.email, account.userId
[SETUP] read GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/settings/MultiFactorAuthentication.Enabled and remember the value as globalBefore; POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/settings with the admin Bearer and body [{"name":"MultiFactorAuthentication.Enabled","valueType":"Boolean","value":true}]; GET it again and require true (the window is open from here)
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer and JSON body {"notificationType":"MfaSignInEmailNotification","keyword":account.email,"sort":"createdDate:desc","take":20}; capture the number of rows as rowsBefore
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=password, scope=offline_access, storeId=store.id, username=account.email, password={{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}
[CAPTURE] resStore = the response (status, keys)
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer and JSON body {"notificationType":"MfaSignInEmailNotification","keyword":account.email,"sort":"createdDate:desc","take":20}; capture the number of rows as rowsAfter

[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=password, scope=offline_access, username=account.email, password={{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}
[CAPTURE] resNoStore = the response (the same Manager, no storeId)
Assertions:
[STATUS] resStore is HTTP 200 with an access_token and no twoFactorToken: the Disabled store applies to every user who signs in with that store id, a Manager included {SPEC} (VCST-5904 comment 112278: Storefront sign-in with a store -> that store's StoreMode for every user: Disabled doesn't require a code)
[COUNT] rowsAfter equals rowsBefore: no code email for the Disabled store {SPEC} (vc-module-mfa#1: Settings: a token request that names a store follows the StoreMode of that store, for every user)
[STATUS] resNoStore is HTTP 400 with two_factor_required: the same Manager without a store follows the global setting, which is on {SPEC} (VCST-5904 comment 112278: Token endpoint without store -> global)
[BODY] resStore and resNoStore differ only by the storeId of the request (same account, same global state) - the non-vacuity pair {SPEC} (vc-module-mfa#1: Settings)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] the fixture creator (mfa-fixtures.mjs) reports no fixtureGap and no errors[] entry for the account kind and the store this case relies on
[API] response bodies are JSON with the documented error shape (error, code) and carry no stack trace
[NETWORK] no 5xx on /connect/token, /api/mfa/* or the journal call
Failure_Signals: the Disabled store still challenges a Manager (the override does not reach every user although the spec says it does); the Manager is NOT challenged store-less (the pair is vacuous: BLOCKED); a 5xx

FIRST, before anything else and even if the case aborted: POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/settings with the admin Bearer minted before the window and body [{"name":"MultiFactorAuthentication.Enabled","valueType":"Boolean","value":globalBefore}], then GET it and require globalBefore (a window left open blocks every other sign-in on the stand)
teardown(runId) of mfa-fixtures.mjs: removes every AGENT-TEST-MFA entity of the run (accounts, contacts, organizations, role, store) and asserts zero residue
